nodes.label: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein Powder (Vanilla, 4.8lb)
nodes.description: Product photo of Optimum Nutrition (ON) Gold Standard 100% Whey protein powder, naturally flavored vanilla variant, 4.8 lb (2.18 kg) container with 68 servings. Label states 24g protein, 5.5g BCAAs, 4g glutamine and glutamic acid per serving. No artificial flavors or sweeteners, gluten free, banned substance free. Black tub with cream/gold label.
